inlines.v: INCU'RABLE, adjective 1. That cannot be cured; not admitting of cure; beyond the power of skill or medicine; as an incurable disease. 2. Not admitting remedy or correction; irremediable; remediless; as incurable evils. INCU'RABLE, noun A person diseased beyond the reach of cure.
